# Design-system graph

How to read a node:

1. `composes` lists the graph nodes the file imports; `composed by` lists who imports it, grouped by area with counts. Stories and tests are not counted. Long lists end in `+N more`; `graph.json` has them all.
2. `style` lists the component classes of a class library such as DaisyUI, the theme colour tokens and the custom properties (`var(--x)`) the file references.
3. `decisions` are the ticket ids found in the file; open the ticket or the file header for the why.
4. `rules` are declared in the file itself as comment lines: `ds:group Tier / Group`, `ds:parents`, `ds:children`, `ds:never`, `ds:use-when`. `ds:no-story <reason>` marks a component that has no story on purpose. A value may wrap onto the comment lines after it.

## Story lane

The story files are read in place: 7 files, with 13 states. A story covers a node directly when its file imports it or sits beside it, and incidentally when the node is reached through the modules that file imports in turn. A node's own story is the one beside it, or one titled with its group and name.

- Direct: 3 · seen only inside a parent's story: 0 · none: 1.

The checks: `story-files` (every story file can be read in full and no two states share an id, and with `stories.policy.cleanIds` every id has one folder per title part), `story-title` (with `stories.policy`: the roots, the number of parts, the text of title parts and state names, the name a story beside a node takes, and title prefixes), `story-own` (`stories.policy.ownStory`: a node has a story of its own), `story-banner` (`stories.policy.bannerByRoot`: a root's files carry its banner key and no other file does) and `no-story` (every live node has a direct story or a `ds:no-story` line). With `graph.strictFaults`, all but the last fail the run; the audit ratchets `no-story`.

- `no-story` · `src/components/Field.tsx` · no direct story
- `story-files` · `src/components/Button.stories.tsx` · LogIn: the id primitives--actions--button--log--in-button splits into 5 levels instead of 4
